findings.before: P=262-(4/3)Q^2 could be read as a valid linear prefix
findings.fix: Full affine parser rejects unsupported nonlinear syntax
Safe arithmetic parser supports standard equivalent linear forms

findings.before: Actor and workspace tolerances could disagree
findings.fix: Both check canonical inverse coefficients to 0.0001

findings.before: Number conversion could turn a blank into zero
findings.fix: numericInput rejects blank and non-numeric types

findings.before: Rejected bakery and wine attempts displayed worked results
findings.fix: Feedback identifies errors without supplying unearned results; unverified table cells remain blank

findings.before: Wine resident diners depended on bakery guest count
findings.fix: Wine dinner forecast is derived only from its own assumptions

findings.before: Escape was ignored in a focused question input
findings.fix: Escape closes the active modal from inputs

findings.before: Deferred initial focus could override student tab navigation
findings.fix: Modal focus wraps and initial focus respects an already-focused modal control

findings.before: Rerendering could re-enable an in-flight question
findings.fix: Per-actor pending state survives rerenders and blocks duplicate submissions

findings.before: Model could append unrelated fact-card entries
findings.fix: Known factual questions cannot credit unrequested facts

findings.before: Model could omit the other observation holder
findings.fix: Hotel observation replies name Marco or Lucia or use an honest fallback

findings.before: Common price and booking misspellings could prevent evidence collection
findings.fix: Small explicit typo normalization preserves factual discovery offline
Persistent warning and honest in-tab-only label if saving fails
Unknown facts cannot invent colleague ownership; hotel referrals apply only to hotel observation holders
Status exposes only valid 40-hex Render commit ID

publication.remaining: Final GitHub CI and release-head confirmation recorded in completion message
publication.evidence: Production files and regression fixtures verified byte-for-byte through Git fetch; hosted status and 24 approved live requests verified.

limitations: Client-delivered formulas and checks are discoverable; this is formative assessment, not secure examination.
Synthetic playthroughs do not establish student learning outcomes or measured completion times.
Free Render instances can cold-start slowly; labelled case-fact fallback preserves evidence access.
Instructor review is required for written economic reasoning.
